# `ecommerce_item_discount_valid`

> A discount can't be negative or larger than the line amount.

| | |
|---|---|
| Domain | [ecommerce](README.md) |
| Layer | **silver** — evaluated by the `silver` gate |
| Model | `slv_ecommerce__order_items` (`ecommerce_silver.slv_ecommerce__order_items`) |
| Check | `expression_is_true` |
| Severity | `error` — a violation **stops the pipeline** |
| Defined in | [dbt/models/ecommerce/silver/_silver.yml](../../../dbt/models/ecommerce/silver/_silver.yml) |

## What it checks

Every row satisfies `discount >= 0 and discount <= gross_amount`.

## When it fails

The `silver` task of `medallion_ecommerce` fails, gold and `publish_gold` don't run, and the batch is never added to `ecommerce_gold`: consumers keep the batches published before. `quality_report` marks the run as blocked and sends the alert, if one is configured.

The rows that broke the rule in its latest evaluation are kept in `dq_audit.ecommerce_item_discount_valid`.

## Tested by

Scenario **`excessive_discount`**: discount larger than the line amount.

```bash
make generate DOMAIN=ecommerce SCENARIO=excessive_discount BATCH=2026-10-20_excessive_discount
make pipeline DOMAIN=ecommerce BATCH=2026-10-20_excessive_discount
```

## Investigate

```sql

-- history of the rule
select batch_id, status, failures, recorded_at
from dq_audit.rule_results
where rule = 'ecommerce_item_discount_valid'
order by recorded_at desc;
```
